unit_tests.outbound_guard: ClientSession requests fail before socket unless hostname is loopback

initial_test_isolation_incident.summary: The first test run preceded local Telegram base URL patching and the outbound guard. It attempted requests with only the fixed synthetic invalid fixture token; Telegram returned 401. No real bot token or user data was used, and no successful API operation occurred.
initial_test_isolation_incident.mitigation: Patched the fixed upstream base to the loopback mock, added a pre-socket loopback-only ClientSession guard, and reran the full suite successfully.

not_run: real bot token, Habab service key, or Google master key
relay restart, enrollment, deployment, Android device, or ADB

parent_follow_up.scopedReview: Gateway auth, fixed target, token forwarding, bounds, lifecycle and tests inspected; one token-validation mismatch corrected
parent_follow_up.tokenGrammar: ASCII numeric bot id 1..20 digits; secret 20..256 allowed characters; total token length <=256 matching Core validation
parent_follow_up.outboundMode: fixture-wide loopback guard; fixed Telegram origin patched to local TestServer
